The text on the stone drum records the history before Qin Shihuang unified the country, filling the historical gap.
It is the earliest stone-carved poetry and seal script in China.
It was first discovered in the first year of Zhenguan in the Tang Dynasty (627) in Baoji City's "Shigu Mountain" (anciently known as "Chen Cang Mountain", the scenic spot was built on this mountain).

It was studied and studied by emperors and literati of all dynasties.

Admission is free. ① Address: Binhe Avenue, Weibin District, Baoji City, Shaanxi Province. ② Transportation: Direct bus, easy to park by car ③ Peak season: None. ④ Duration: 0.5 days. 2.
Baoji Bronze Museum is a national first-class museum with bronze culture as its theme.
It houses countless bronze cultural relics from more than 2,000 years ago.
The building is a four-story square built against the mountain, surrounded by a sloping dome in the center like a stone drum.

You can hire a guide in the exhibition hall, which is divided into 7 halls, namely: "Hometown of Bronze" (summarizes the unearthed bronzes near Baoji and displays a large number of precious cultural relics), "State of Zhou Li" (bronze products of the Zhou Dynasty, including wax statues, tombs restored according to the real placement, and pre-Qin chariots and horses, which are very immersive), "Road to Empire" (showing the migration trajectory of the Qin people and the process of the Qin State from weak to strong and finally unifying China.

The Qin people have taken root in Baoji for more than 400 years), "Light of Wisdom" (the center is a circle of bronze making process Sculpture), "Looking at the Mirror with Yellow Flowers" (displaying ancient mirrors, the sculpture of a lady looking at the mirror in the center is very beautiful, it is a photo spot), "Pottery Language Tells the Spring and Autumn Period" (displaying ancient pottery, the small clay sculpture of the pottery making process in the center is very vivid), "The Moon Shines on the Jade" (displaying ancient jades, the crystal jades are dazzling under the ancient background and lighting), and there are graphic exhibitions "Wandering Wanderers" and "Homesickness" in the hall, both of which introduce the Baoji bronzes lost overseas, as well as Chinese and foreign celebrities who have made great contributions to the protection and recovery of Chinese cultural relics.

The spectacular "Zhou Culture Wall" is embedded in the natural cliff on the north side of the museum, telling a series of important events in the Zhou Dynasty starting from the "birth of Hou Ji", showing the development and growth history of the Zhou and Qin nationalities.
The pink flowers beside the wall are brilliant and beautiful. 3.
Go west out of the museum and pass through the garden sculpture area first.

This area is composed of many small gardens, including the "Five Virtues Garden" (composed of 5 small gardens: the "Ren Garden" has a sculpture "Yu Rui Dispute", which tells the story of the kings of Yu and Rui going to the Zhou Dynasty to dispute over land and being influenced by the Zhou Dynasty's etiquette and benevolence; the "Yi Garden" has a sculpture "Tai Bo Runs to Wu", which tells the story of Tai Bo and Zhong Yong giving up the throne of Wu to their younger brother Ji Li; the "Li Garden" has a sculpture "Duke Zhou Establishes Rituals" to commemorate the brother of King Wen of Zhou, Duke Zhou Ji Dan, who established the ritual and music system...

*   Baoji | China Shigu Garden | China Shigu Garden. ◾️China Shigu Garden is a free urban park in Baoji City, located on Shigu Mountain.
It is named after the "first ancient Chinese artifact" - the stone drum - that was unearthed here.

The Bronze Museum is located in the park and is a cultural ecological park that integrates site protection, bronze exhibition, stone drum culture display, garden sightseeing, and leisure and entertainment. ◾️China Shigu Garden is adjacent to the Yinxiang River in the east, the main peak of the Qinling Mountains, Jifeng Mountain, in the south, the city in the west, and the Weihe River in the north.
The environment is beautiful, the facilities are complete, and the view is wide.

Whether it is the elderly who exercise in the morning or children who play, they can find a place of their own here. ◾️Shigu Pavilion, located on the top of Shigu Mountain, is the main building of China Shigu Garden and a landmark building in Baoji City.

It is built in the style of Qin architecture, with a height of 56.9 meters and a five-story exterior and nine-story interior, implying the lofty status of Zhou and Qin civilization in the history and culture of the Chinese nation.
When you climb the Shigu Pavilion, you will see a very large square in front of you, surrounded by green trees.
In addition to tourists, this is also a place for local residents to relax and play.

*   Travel Back in Time to the Stone Drum Garden 1.
Itinerary • Morning: • Depart from downtown Baoji and take a bus or taxi to the Stone Drum Garden.
After entering the park, head straight to the Stone Drum Pavilion, the core attraction of the park and a great place to overlook the city of Baoji.

Inside the pavilion, take a close look at the precious replicas of the stone drums and learn about the profound historical and cultural connotations of the stone drum inscriptions. • Noon: • Enjoy Baoji cuisine at a specialty restaurant in the park, such as Qishan minced noodles and Baoji hand-rolled noodles, and experience the local flavors of Baoji. • Afternoon: • Visit the Bronze Museum, which houses a rich collection of bronzes that are like history books, silently telling the glorious past of Baoji.
Then stroll through the park's gardens and enjoy the beauty of the flowers, trees, and ancient buildings, and feel the tranquility and elegance. 2.
Highlights • Stone Drum Pavilion: The pavilion is built in the style of the Qin and Han dynasties and is magnificent.
The stone drum inscriptions displayed in the pavilion are ancient and powerful, and are the earliest stone inscriptions in China, with high literary and artistic value.

From the top of the pavilion, you can see the city of Baoji, the Weihe River, and the rolling mountains. • Bronze Museum: The museum has a unique shape and displays a large number of bronze treasures unearthed in Baoji, such as the Zun.
These bronzes are not only exquisite in craftsmanship, but also provide valuable information for the study of the history, culture, and politics of the Western Zhou Dynasty. 3.
Cultural Experience • Occasionally, folk artists perform traditional Baoji opera, such as Qin opera, in the Stone Drum Cultural Square.

Visitors can stop to enjoy the high-pitched and infectious singing of Qin opera and appreciate the unique folk culture of the Guanzhong region. • Participate in a bronze replica craft experience (if available) and make a small souvenir with bronze elements to experience the magic and greatness of ancient bronze casting. 4.

Travel Tips • Tickets: You can book online in advance to enjoy a discount. • Opening hours: Plan your itinerary carefully to avoid missing important attractions. • Transportation: There are several bus lines in the city, or you can take a taxi, which is convenient.
